note: Option text is what each option read, not the owner's reasoning (lesson 42). None is applied yet.

answers.title: Does a browser's saved copy also time out?
answers.owner_words: pressed "Same rule, same time" on the page
answers.read: The browser's copy clears on its next connection and stops showing after the same time-out as the Apple app. One value, which you still set.

answers.title: Is a 3-month model on probation judged like the 6 and 12-month ones?
answers.owner_words: pressed "Pairs when there are any" on the page
answers.read: A 3-month model is judged on any pairs that mature in its 4 weeks, from forecasts it made in shadow, and is checked for clean running too. With no pairs, clean running only.

answers.title: May an investment alert ever break quiet hours?
answers.owner_words: picked "Never for investment alerts (Recommended)" on the question card in chat
answers.read: An approved exception can only be one of the critical security or service faults. Every investment alert waits for 07:30, and MP-138 says so.

answers.title: Which faults are critical enough to break quiet hours?
answers.owner_words: picked "A short named list (Recommended)" on the question card in chat
answers.read: Proposed: a sign-in, passkey or recovery you did not start; a device revoke that fails; production lost (ADM-05); and a failed backup or ledger write. Everything else, such as a missed run or a stalled collector, waits for 07:30.

answers.title: For range forecasts, does the baseline stand in for the rules without a yes each time?
answers.owner_words: pressed "Once, as a standing rule" on the page
answers.read: You approve once that for range tasks the strongest simple range baseline stands in for the rules. Each promotion screen names it, and you still approve every promotion.

answers.title: Does a model's live trial need no 2% lead and no 95% interval?
answers.owner_words: pressed "Confirm: no hurdle, no interval" on the page
answers.read: A lower average score than each comparator on the same matured forecasts is enough in the trial. The 2% hurdle and the 95% interval stay in the walk-forward test only.

answers.title: How should the three builds your picks added be carried in the stories?
answers.owner_words: pressed "Widen three existing stories" on the page
answers.read: MP-47 gains the unlock step, MP-107 the factsheet reader and MP-163 the two builds.

answers.title: Now that the repository is public, does route A stand for production releases?
answers.owner_words: pressed "An environment replaces route A" on the page
answers.read: A merge to main starts the release, which waits in the production environment for your approval.

answers.title: Must the first event wave cover all seven kinds, or only what official sources cover?
answers.owner_words: pressed "All seven, gaps shown" on the page
answers.read: All seven stay the target. A kind that no checked source covers shows as no source yet, and informs no forecast until one qualifies.

answers.title: Which days are valuation days for gold and silver?
answers.owner_words: pressed "The provider's bar days" on the page
answers.read: Each day the provider publishes a daily bar is a valuation day. A missing bar is recorded as missing, never filled.

answers.title: Should Apple builds and simulator runs move to GitHub's free macOS runners?
answers.pick: Build and unit tests in CI
answers.owner_words: pressed "Build and unit tests in CI" on the page
answers.read: Each pull request that touches the Apple app builds it and runs XCTest on a free macOS runner. Maestro journeys and real-device builds stay on your Mac.
